entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CarouselView vertical snap points ignored on iOS with Microsoft.Maui.Controls v10.0.20 (regression from v9.0.120) #33308
  • The Picker is still binding to the property and reacts to data changes after the page is closed. #33307
  • XAML SG could warn when binding to a readonly property #33306
  • [Android] TitleView defined in Shell is lost when changing tabs #33304

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/inflight/current` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #33261
